text: REJECT: the patch assigns the `string?` result of `ParentOrNull` to `dir` without changing how `dir` is declared or what the loop condition is. In the original, `dir` was only ever assigned a non-null `parent`, so it is almost certainly a non-nullable `string`. Assigning a possibly-null value to it raises a nullable warning, which fails the build with warnings as errors. If the loop is `while (true)`, the walk no longer ends at the filesystem root and the next iteration passes a null `dir` onward, which changes behaviour.
